pristine.sourcePolicy: All byte-exact 11.0.1 source and test files, strict published declaration contracts, and paired repository-authored probes.

adapted.sourcePolicy: Strict authored source, public export contracts and paired repository-authored probes after permitted import transformations.

permittedTransformations.rule: React probes import vendored upstream/src; Octane probes import the package public entry
Matching @ts-expect-error controls must reject the same invalid call shapes on both sides
